title: Clearer Skyblock generators and safer minigame queues
summary: Java players can reach and understand their generator, see upgrade affordability, and prepare their inventory for a queued minigame without a false server error.
body:
- The Java and Bedrock generator menu now separates mining, warehouse access and upgrades. A dedicated action teleports the player safely within reach of the regenerating block and explains that its drops are picked up from the world.
- Generator upgrades show the island bank balance, price and missing amount before confirmation. An insufficient balance is presented as a normal economy outcome with a direct path to the merchant, not as a technical server failure.
- Joining a minigame queue from Skyblock keeps the queue intent active. If Skyblock items still block the eventual hand-off, the existing deposit-all screen opens automatically so the player can prepare without guessing a command.
- A protected inventory exit is no longer logged as a fatal lobby teleport error. Real destination-load and teleport failures remain high-severity server errors.
- The compact Skyblock HUD refreshes before Minecraft fades the action bar, removing the repeated disappear-and-return effect while keeping database refreshes bounded.
- All new menu guidance is localized across Cookie Build's supported server languages.

Java: play.cookie-build.com
Bedrock: play.cookie-build.com, port 19132
